name: Konjiki no Yami
source:
A girl from space with a withdrawn personality. She remains reserved to herself and focuses on her own goals. Tends to fear slimy things, including tentacles.

Yami was originally hired to assassinate Rito. But instead, she stayed on Earth while maintaining the mission as an excuse. She's been keeping a close eye on him since then.
